points.cause_effect: This major institutional adoption will increase the utility and perceived value of Solana, leading to higher demand for SOL and upward price pressure over time.

parsed.thesis: Solana is positioned for substantial long-term value appreciation driven by increasing institutional adoption and a rapidly expanding DeFi ecosystem, making it a compelling BUY.
